definitions.gloss: breast (of a woman or female mammal)
definitions.explanation: The breast, as a part of the body that produces milk. A neutral, somewhat formal word used in medicine, art and writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{乳房|ちぶさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}う→吸う：04394_suu⟧。
examples.english: The baby sucks at the breast.

examples.japanese: {乳房|ちぶさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しこり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
